TaskDescription: Modified heights stimulus in VR, adapted to the mobility constraints of the epilepsy patients: seated in a chair in a virtual copy of their hospital room, playing the 'lights-out' task (4 x 4 light grid) in front of them; 1 min into the task the walls and floor of the virtual room fall away, leaving the subject seated on a platform of a building 50 stories high. iEEG recorded 5 min before the onset of the modified heights stimulus ("No Visual Stim") and during the stimulus (Yilmaz Balban et al. 2021 Curr Biol 31:601-612.e3, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2020.11.035, STAR Methods).
Instructions: Patients played the 'lights-out' task (turn off all lights of a 4 x 4 grid; clicking a light toggles it and its neighbours) while seated in the virtual hospital room (Yilmaz Balban et al. 2021 Curr Biol 31:601-612.e3, doi:10.1016/j.cub.2020.11.035, STAR Methods).
InstitutionName: University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) Hospital
ManufacturersModelName: PZ2 (256-channel) or PZ5 (512-channel) amplifier with RZ2 digital acquisition system
iEEGReference: Not documented in the release (TDT raw export).
iEEGPlacementScheme: Clinically determined implant for seizure localization; subdural grid (64 contacts) and strips (36 contacts) per the electrode table of the release
iEEGElectrodeGroups: Electrode leads of the release electrode table: FG (grid, 64 contacts), FS (strip, 6 contacts), IHA (strip, 6 contacts), IHB (strip, 4 contacts), IHC (strip, 6 contacts), FPA (strip, 6 contacts), FPB (strip, 4 contacts), OFC (strip, 4 contacts). The mapping of TDT inputs (ch001..) to these leads is not documented in the release.

iEEGGround: n/a (not documented in the paper or the release)
